name: Your Company
tagline: A language school where only the first five minutes are scary
niche: Language school: English, Korean and German for kids and adults

seo.title: Your Company — language school in Tashkent: English, Korean
seo.description: English, Korean and German for children from 6 and adults. Groups of up to 8, IELTS and TOPIK preparation, and a free trial lesson.
seo.answer: Your Company is a language school in Tashkent at 54 Nukus St. We teach English, Korean and German to children from age 6 and adults in groups of up to 8. A month of classes starts from 690,000 UZS (3 lessons a week); IELTS preparation takes 4 months. The first lesson and level test are free.

listing.description: A website for a language school, kids’ centre or online courses. Bright and bouncy: a mascot that follows the cursor, programme cards, a level-by-level learning path, formats and prices.

sections.title: Speak a new language within a month
sections.subtitle: Groups of up to 8, real teachers and lessons where the students do the talking, not the teacher. The first lesson is free.

sections.label: About us
sections.title: We teach so the language becomes a habit
sections.text: Since 2018, more than three thousand students have been through our groups. Students talk for 70% of every lesson: discussing, debating, playing and solving problems. Between lessons there are 10-minute daily tasks in a Telegram bot, so the language doesn’t slip away over the weekend. Once a month there’s a speaking club with native speakers.

sections.label: Programmes
sections.title: Choose your programme
sections.intro: Every programme starts with a free level test and a trial lesson.

items.title: English for adults
items.text: From zero to a confident B2: speaking, grammar without cramming, business correspondence.

items.title: English for kids

items.title: Exam or goal
items.text: IELTS, TOPIK, a job interview or a move abroad — we see you through to the result.

items.name: One-to-one
features: Time that suits you, online or in person
A programme built around your goal

items.quote: In four months I went from 5.5 to 7.0 in IELTS. The most useful part was the mock tests every two weeks: by exam day it wasn’t scary anymore.
items.author: Sevara
items.role: IELTS 7.0, got into a master’s programme

items.quote: My son reminds me himself that it’s English day. He used to barely say a word — now he sings songs and argues with his teacher.
items.author: Olga

items.quote: I started Korean from scratch before a job in Seoul. Six months later I can easily get by in shops and at work.
items.author: Jasur

items.q: Is the trial lesson really free?
items.a: Yes. The trial lesson lasts 60 minutes and includes a level test. Afterwards you decide whether to stay — no obligation.

items.q: How do you determine my level?
items.a: Take the test: 15 minutes of writing and 5 minutes of conversation with a teacher. Based on the results, we’ll suggest a group at the right level.
Yes, all programmes are available online: the same teachers and groups of up to 8, classes on Zoom, tasks in the Telegram bot.

items.q: From what age do you take children?
items.a: From age 6. Children study in age groups: 6–8, 9–10 and 11–12; teenagers from 13 join adult groups at their level.

items.q: What if I miss a lesson?
items.a: You’ll get the lesson recording and materials on Telegram. You can catch up on the topic at the speaking club or join a parallel group at the same level.
Yes. If you stop studying, we refund all unused lessons in the current month within 10 working days.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: Your first lesson is on us
sections.text: Call or message us on Telegram — we’ll find a convenient time for the test and trial lesson.
